name: x_ads-mcp
description: X Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool

platform_mcp_x_ads_consumer_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_X_ADS_CONSUMER_KEY
platform_mcp_x_ads_consumer_key.description: API Key (consumer key) of an X developer app approved for Ads API access (Ads API Access Form, https://docs.x.com/forms/ads-api-access).

platform_mcp_x_ads_consumer_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_X_ADS_CONSUMER_SECRET
platform_mcp_x_ads_consumer_secret.description: API Key Secret (consumer secret) of the same app.

platform_mcp_x_ads_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_X_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_x_ads_access_token.description: OAuth 1.0a user access token of an X user with access to the ads account (app management UI or the 3-legged OAuth flow).

platform_mcp_x_ads_access_token_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_X_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
platform_mcp_x_ads_access_token_secret.description: OAuth 1.0a access token secret belonging to that access token.

platform_mcp_x_ads_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_X_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_x_ads_account_id.description: Ads account id (e.g. 18ce54d4x5t) used by update_budget and pause_resume, whose inputs carry only the campaign id; list_accounts shows the ids.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /12/accounts?count=1: the advertising accounts the authenticating user can access.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /12/accounts (count ≤ 1000, cursor pagination via next_cursor). Each account has id, name, timezone, business_id, approval_status, deleted.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /12/accounts/:account_id/campaigns (count ≤ 1000, cursor pagination). Each campaign has id, name, entity_status (ACTIVE/PAUSED/DRAFT), effective_status, daily_budget_amount_local_micro and total_budget_amount_local_micro (micro units: $5.50 = 5500000, left in raw), currency, funding_instrument_id. status is not sent (no status filter is documented).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Synchronous analytics: GET /12/stats/accounts/:account_id?entity=CAMPAIGN&entity_ids=<campaign_id>&start_time&end_time&granularity=DAY&metric_groups=ENGAGEMENT,BILLING&placement=ALL_ON_TWITTER. campaign_id is required in practice (entity_ids is required, up to 20 comma-separated ids) and the window may span at most 7 days. Each row is {id, id_data: [{segment, metrics: {impressions: [...], clicks, billed_charge_local_micro, …}}]} with one array element per day; spend is in micro units. X Audience Platform placements need a separate request.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /12/accounts/:account_id/campaigns/:campaign_id?daily_budget_amount_local_micro=… (the configured account_id; micro units of the funding instrument's currency, 'For USD, $5.50 is represented as 5500000'; must not exceed the total budget). This spends money. currency is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /12/accounts/:account_id/campaigns/:campaign_id?entity_status=ACTIVE|PAUSED (the configured account_id). Resuming restarts spend.
